entries.summary: This needs a person: a code typed at a console. For promote and apply, an agent grant also works.
causes: no_console: no terminal a person can type into
not_confirmed, timeout, too_many_attempts: the person did not confirm
grant_needs_yes: a grant exists, but --yes was not passed
entries.what_to_do: Stop and give the human the command in next. It needs a person at a console; for promote and apply, an agent grant made with ghostbranch agents allow also works (feature close and remove ignore grants). Never fake a terminal, answer the code, edit grants.json or run ghostbranch agents allow yourself.
